name: Project Spring Break
source:
New day, new guests, and stories from places I've never been.

Project Spring Break is a visual novel game where you play as Nyai, an innkeeper of the peculiar motel called Spring Inn. 

The guests are coming with their stories and social dissonance. With your hospitality and magical warm drinks, you can let them decide their own resolve or help them reconcile with each other. The choice is yours.

[from [url=https://mojiken.itch.io/project-spring-break]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新的一天，新的客人，还有来自我从未去过之处的故事。

《Project Spring Break》是一款视觉小说。你将扮演Nyai，一家名为“春日旅店”的奇特汽车旅馆的老板。

客人们带着各自的故事，以及与社会的格格不入前来。凭借热情招待与神奇的热饮，你可以让他们自行寻找决心，也可以帮助他们彼此和解。选择权在你。

[摘自[url=https://mojiken.itch.io/project-spring-break]itch.io[/url]]
